statement: VCG/SPA for tCPA bidders is non-monotone in both revenue and welfare; constructed counterexample shows a simultaneous ~6.2% decrease (Theorem 5.8).
method: Reconstructed the paper's explicit B.1 four-impression instance; ran SPA (VCG) per impression with the published canonical CPA-binding equilibrium multipliers.

auction_format_FPA.description: Same instance under FPA (mu=1 uniform bidding). By Theorem 5.1 revenue must be monotone; the VCG 6.2% drop must vanish, confirming it is driven by VCG's second-price payment, not by model refinement.
